why: An arXiv preprint (2609.14281, Sept 2026) proves every 4-partite 4-uniform hypergraph with matching number 2 satisfies tau<=6, closing the (r,nu)=(4,2) case of Ryser's conjecture and improving the prior bound of tau<=7 from Haxell-Scott. Also found an August 2025 paper offering new sufficient conditions under which the conjecture holds, though not a full proof.
